about_short_description.short_description: Al Jouf Cement is a concrete company that provides reinforced concrete.

product.name: Portland Cement
product.description: A general-purpose cement used primarily for construction and concrete foundations, produced according to Gulf and American standards.

product.name: Sulfate-Resistant Cement
product.description: Cement designed for use in environments exposed to sulfate attack, such as soil, groundwater, or seawater contact areas.

product.name: Super 20 Cement
product.description: A low-heat, environmentally considerate cement suitable for large concrete works, enhancing concrete strength and durability.

product.name: Finishing Cement
product.description: A fine-textured cement designed for surface finishing, decoration, and brick manufacturing, producing smooth and even surfaces.

product.name: Clinker
product.description: A primary raw material produced for cement manufacturing, used as the base component in cement production.
